tips.title: Create an assignment
tips.summary: Post homework, projects, and classwork.
tips.description: Post homework, projects, and classwork.
tips.keywords: post homework projects classwork create

tip_steps.step_description: Open Classwork for this class.
Choose Create to start a classwork post.
Add the assignment title, instructions, attachments, and due date, then choose Assign, Schedule, or Save draft.

tips.title: Grade and return assignments
tips.summary: Review student work and enter grades.
tips.description: Review student work and enter grades.
tips.keywords: grade return review student work score

tip_steps.step_description: Open Classwork, then choose the assignment you want to review.
Review a student's work, enter a grade or feedback, then return it when ready.

tips.title: Post a class announcement
tips.summary: Share reminders, updates, and instructions.
tips.description: Share reminders, updates, and instructions.
tips.keywords: announcement reminder update instructions stream

tip_steps.step_description: Open the class Stream.
Start a new announcement.
Write the announcement, choose the class and students, then post or schedule it.

tips.title: Find missing work
tips.summary: Identify students who haven't submitted assignments.
tips.description: Identify students who haven't submitted assignments.
tips.keywords: missing late not submitted work status students

tip_steps.step_description: Open Classwork, then choose the assignment you want to review.
Use the work-status list or status filter to find students marked Missing, then follow up as needed.

tips.title: Post class materials
tips.summary: Upload presentations, worksheets, and documents.
tips.description: Upload presentations, worksheets, and documents.
tips.keywords: upload presentations worksheets documents resource classwork

tip_steps.step_description: Open Classwork.
Choose Create to add a class resource.
Choose Material, add a title and attachments, optionally choose a topic, then post or schedule it.

tips.title: Create a quiz assignment
tips.summary: Create a test or quiz with Google Forms.
tips.description: Create a test or quiz with Google Forms.
tips.keywords: quiz test Google Forms questions auto grade

tip_steps.step_description: Open Classwork.
Choose Create to start a quiz assignment.
Choose Quiz assignment, edit the attached Google Form, set assignment details, and assign or schedule it.

tips.title: Give feedback on student work
tips.summary: Leave comments and suggestions on assignments.
tips.description: Leave comments and suggestions on assignments.
tips.keywords: comments suggestions feedback student work comment bank

tip_steps.step_description: Open Classwork, then choose the assignment you want to review.
Add a private comment or feedback on the work, then save or return the assignment.

tips.title: Open the gradebook
tips.summary: View and manage student grades.
tips.description: View and manage student grades.
tips.keywords: gradebook student grades scores download

tip_steps.step_description: Open Grades for the class.
Review the gradebook, update a student's score if needed, or download a copy from the Grades page.

tips.title: Schedule an assignment
tips.summary: Set an assignment to become available later.
tips.description: Set an assignment to become available later.
tips.keywords: schedule publish later assignment due date

tip_steps.step_description: Open Classwork.
Create an assignment and fill in its details.
Open the menu beside Assign, choose Schedule, set the publish date and time, and confirm Schedule.

tips.title: Manage students in a class
tips.summary: Add, remove, and organize students into classes.
tips.description: Add, remove, and organize students into classes.
tips.keywords: students invite add remove organize class roster

tip_steps.step_description: Open the class People page.
Choose the student invite control.
Invite students by email or class code. To remove a student, use the menu beside their name.

tips.title: Create a quiz
tips.summary: Build a custom multiple-choice quiz.
tips.description: Build a custom multiple-choice quiz.
tips.keywords: create build custom multiple choice quiz kahoot

tip_steps.step_description: Start a new kahoot.
Add your first question.
Enter the question and answer choices, mark the correct answer, and save the kahoot.

tips.title: Host a live game
tips.summary: Run an interactive classroom competition.
tips.description: Run an interactive classroom competition.
tips.keywords: host live game classroom competition start

tip_steps.step_description: Open your library and choose a kahoot.
Choose Host live to set up a game.
Choose the game experience and settings, share the PIN with students, then start when they have joined.

tips.title: Find a ready-made kahoot
tips.summary: Find and reuse quizzes made by other teachers.
tips.description: Find and reuse quizzes made by other teachers.
tips.keywords: premade ready made search discover reuse teacher quizzes

tip_steps.step_description: Browse Discover for existing kahoots.
Search for a topic or quiz.
Preview a result, then save it to your library or duplicate it if that option is available.

tips.title: Assign a homework challenge
tips.summary: Assign a kahoot students complete independently.
tips.description: Assign a kahoot students complete independently.
tips.keywords: homework challenge assign self paced due date

tip_steps.step_description: Open your library and choose a kahoot.
Choose Assign to make a self-paced challenge.
Set the deadline and options, then share the assignment link or PIN with students.

tips.title: Review game reports
tips.summary: Review student scores and class results.
tips.description: Review student scores and class results.
tips.keywords: performance reports scores results students analytics

tip_steps.step_description: Open Reports.
Select a game report to review class results, player scores, and question-by-question performance.

tips.title: Add from the question bank
tips.summary: Find existing questions to add to a kahoot.
tips.description: Find existing questions to add to a kahoot.
tips.keywords: question bank existing questions add quiz

tip_steps.step_description: Open the kahoot creator.
Choose Add question to browse question types and sources.
Open the question bank, search or browse, and add a question to your kahoot.

tips.title: Add a true or false question
tips.summary: Quickly check student understanding with a true-or-false question.
tips.description: Quickly check student understanding with a true-or-false question.
tips.keywords: true false question quick check understanding

tip_steps.step_description: Open the kahoot creator.
Choose Add question.
Select True/False, write a statement, mark the correct response, and save it.

tips.title: Collect responses with a poll
tips.summary: Collect student opinions and responses.
tips.description: Collect student opinions and responses.
tips.keywords: poll opinions responses survey question

tip_steps.step_description: Open the kahoot creator.
Choose Add question.
Select Poll if it is available on your plan, enter the prompt and choices, and save it.

tips.title: Play in team mode
tips.summary: Let students compete in groups.
tips.description: Let students compete in groups.
tips.keywords: team groups teams competition live game

tip_steps.step_description: Choose a kahoot from your library.
Start a live game setup.
Choose Team mode in the game experience settings, set team options, and start the game.

tips.title: Generate quiz questions with AI
tips.summary: Generate questions from a topic or learning material.
tips.description: Generate questions from a topic or learning material.
tips.keywords: AI generate quiz questions topic learning material

tip_steps.step_description: Start a new kahoot.
Choose the AI question generator.
Enter a topic or add learning material, review the generated questions, edit them, and save.

tips.title: Award behavior points
tips.summary: Recognize positive behavior and participation.
tips.description: Recognize positive behavior and participation.
tips.keywords: behavior points reward positive participation skills

tip_steps.step_description: Open your class view.
Open the point-awarding controls.
Choose a student and a skill to award a point. Check the selected student before confirming.

tips.title: Message a parent
tips.summary: Send a private message directly to a student's family.
tips.description: Send a private message directly to a student's family.
tips.keywords: parent message family chat private

tip_steps.step_description: Open Messages or Chats.
Choose the family conversation, write your message, and send it when ready.

tips.title: Post a class story
tips.summary: Share classroom photos, videos, and updates with families.
tips.description: Share classroom photos, videos, and updates with families.
tips.keywords: class story photos videos updates families post

tip_steps.step_description: Open the class story feed.
Start a new story post.
Add an update or media, check the audience, and publish the post.

tips.title: Share student portfolio work
tips.summary: Share student projects and completed work.
tips.description: Share student projects and completed work.
tips.keywords: student portfolio projects completed work activity share

tip_steps.step_description: Open the portfolio area for your class.
Choose a student or portfolio post, review the work, and share or approve it using the available controls.

tips.title: Record attendance
tips.summary: Record student attendance for your class.
tips.description: Record student attendance for your class.
tips.keywords: attendance absent present record students

tip_steps.step_description: Open the attendance tool for your class.
Mark each student present or absent and save the attendance record.

tips.title: Set a classroom timer
tips.summary: Set a timer for an activity or transition.
tips.description: Set a timer for an activity or transition.
tips.keywords: classroom timer activity transition countdown

tip_steps.step_description: Open the classroom tools menu.
Choose Timer.
Set the time and start the countdown for the activity.

tips.title: Pick a student at random
tips.summary: Randomly select a student to participate.
tips.description: Randomly select a student to participate.
tips.keywords: random student picker choose participate

tip_steps.step_description: Open the classroom tools menu.
Choose the random student picker.
Use the picker to select a student, then reset or remove the student from the draw if your class needs it.

tips.title: Make student groups
tips.summary: Organize students into groups for an activity.
tips.description: Organize students into groups for an activity.
tips.keywords: group maker organize students teams

tip_steps.step_description: Open the classroom tools menu.
Choose Group Maker.
Choose how many groups or students per group, generate the groups, and adjust them as needed.

tips.title: Send a class announcement
tips.summary: Send important information to families.
tips.description: Send important information to families.
tips.keywords: class announcement families message all parents

tip_steps.step_description: Open Messages or Chats.
Start a new message.
Choose the class or family group, write the announcement, and send it.

tips.title: Review behavior reports
tips.summary: Review student behavior and participation patterns.
tips.description: Review student behavior and participation patterns.
tips.keywords: behavior reports participation patterns points progress

tip_steps.step_description: Open Reports for your class.
Choose a student or date range and review the points and behavior patterns shown in the report.

tips.title: Create and edit slides
tips.summary: Add, duplicate, delete, and rearrange slides in a presentation.
tips.description: Use the filmstrip on the left to build a clear lesson sequence. Add a slide, reuse one by duplicating it, drag slides into a better order, or remove slides you no longer need.
tips.keywords: create add edit slides new duplicate copy delete remove reorder rearrange move filmstrip

tip_steps.step_description: Choose New slide to add a slide after the one selected in the filmstrip.
In the left filmstrip, drag a slide to rearrange it. Right-click a thumbnail to duplicate or delete it. You can also select a thumbnail and press Delete or Backspace to remove it.

tips.title: Templates and themes
tips.summary: Start with a premade design or apply a theme and slide layout.
tips.description: Templates and themes give your lesson a consistent look without formatting every slide from scratch. A template can add a complete set of designed slides; a theme updates the presentation's colors, fonts, and layouts.
tips.keywords: template theme design premade layout style gallery import theme

tip_steps.step_description: Open the template gallery from the top-left of the Slides home screen or editor.

Choose a template to start a designed presentation. To restyle an open deck, choose Slide > Change theme, then select a theme in the right panel. Use Layout in the toolbar to change the selected slide's arrangement.

tips.title: Text formatting
tips.summary: Adjust fonts, size, color, and alignment to make lesson content easy to read.
tips.description: Clear formatting helps students scan instructions and focus on key ideas. Select text inside a text box, then use the toolbar to change its font, size, color, and alignment.
tips.keywords: text format font fonts color colour size alignment align typography bold

tip_steps.step_description: Find the font controls in the toolbar at the top of the editor.
Select text on the slide. Use the toolbar to choose a font and size, set Text color, and choose an alignment. If the text is not selected, the changes may apply only to new text.

tips.title: Insert images
tips.summary: Add a picture, illustration, or diagram to support a lesson.
tips.description: A relevant visual can make a concept easier to explain. Slides can insert images from your computer, Google Drive, Photos, the web, or a URL.
tips.keywords: insert image picture photo illustration diagram upload drive web url visual

tip_steps.step_description: Open Insert in the top menu.
Choose Image to see the available image sources.
Choose a source, select the picture, then click Insert or Open. Drag the image to position it and use the corner handles to resize it.

tips.title: Insert videos
tips.summary: Embed a video in a slide so students can watch it during the lesson.
tips.description: You can search YouTube, paste a video URL, or choose a video stored in Google Drive. The video appears on the slide and can play during a presentation.
tips.keywords: insert video youtube embed lesson clip url drive

tip_steps.step_description: Open Insert in the top menu.
Choose Video to open the video picker.
Search YouTube, paste a video URL, or choose a video from Drive. Select the video and click Select, then position and resize it on the slide.

tips.title: Speaker notes
tips.summary: Keep private teaching prompts below a slide while you present.
tips.description: Speaker notes help you remember examples, questions, or transitions. They appear in presenter tools for you and are not shown on the audience's slide.
tips.keywords: speaker notes presenter private talking points teaching prompts below slide

tip_steps.step_description: Locate the speaker notes area below the current slide.
Click the notes area and type your teaching prompt. Select another slide to add notes for that part of the lesson. The notes stay in the editor and presenter view, not on the projected slide.

tips.title: Animations and transitions
tips.summary: Reveal text or images gradually and add transitions between slides.
tips.description: Animations can introduce an object or list one piece at a time. Transitions control how a slide appears during the presentation, helping you pace explanations and keep attention on the current idea.
tips.keywords: animation transition reveal gradually appear on click motion slide objects

tip_steps.step_description: Select the text or image you want to animate, then open Insert.
Choose Animation to open the motion controls.
Choose an object animation and set when it starts. To add a slide transition instead, select a slide and choose Slide > Transition. Use Play in the motion panel to preview your changes.

tips.title: Charts and tables
tips.summary: Show data, comparisons, and information visually on a slide.
tips.description: A chart can make class data or comparisons easier to understand. Tables are useful for organizing information into rows and columns, and charts can stay linked to their source spreadsheet.
tips.keywords: chart table data comparisons information visual insert spreadsheet sheets linked

tip_steps.step_description: Open Insert in the top menu.
Choose Chart to add a chart, or choose Table from the same Insert menu to organize information in rows and columns.
For a chart, select the chart type or choose From Sheets to import one. For a table, choose its row and column count. Move and resize the result on your slide.

tips.title: Sharing and collaboration
tips.summary: Give teachers or students the right access to view, comment, or edit.
tips.description: Sharing lets colleagues co-plan lessons and gives students access to class presentations. Choose a permission level that fits the task, and check who can open the link before sending it.
tips.keywords: share collaboration collaborate co-edit teacher student viewer commenter editor permission link

tip_steps.step_description: Open the sharing controls in the top-right corner.
Add people or copy a link. Choose Viewer, Commenter, or Editor access, check the sharing scope, then send or copy the link. Editors can change the presentation; viewers can only see it.

tips.title: Present mode
tips.summary: Show your deck full-screen and use presenter view for notes and controls.
tips.description: Slideshow mode puts the lesson on the class display. Presenter view can keep speaker notes and presentation controls available to you while students see the slides.
tips.keywords: present presentation slideshow full screen presenter view notes tools class display

tip_steps.step_description: Start the full-screen presentation from the top-right of the editor.
Use the arrow keys or on-screen arrows to move through the slides, and press Esc to exit. To keep notes and presenter controls available, open the Slideshow options and choose Presenter view.

tips.title: Give feedback on student writing
tips.summary: Attach a clear comment to a specific sentence in a student's work.
tips.description: Open a student's Google Doc with permission to comment or edit. Select a passage and attach actionable feedback so the student knows exactly what to revise.
tips.keywords: student writing essay paper feedback comment comments review grade highlight select text sentence revision revise

tip_steps.step_description: Open a student's document and drag across the sentence you want to give feedback on. You need Commenter or Editor access to add a comment.
Click Add comment in the toolbar at the top of the document. Keep the sentence selected so your feedback attaches to it.
Type specific feedback, such as "Add an example to support this idea." Click the blue Comment button to post it. The comment stays attached to the selected sentence for the student to review.

tips.title: Start a classroom poster from a template
tips.summary: Find a classroom poster template, then customize it for your students.
tips.description: Start on Canva's home page at canva.com. Open Templates, then use the template search to find a classroom poster.
tips.keywords: poster template templates classroom bulletin board decorations flyer design search

tip_steps.step_description: On Canva's home page, click Templates in the left sidebar or above the search bar. If you are editing a design, go to canva.com first.
Click the template search box near the top of the Templates page. Follow the orange mouse pointer and highlight to the search field.
Type "classroom poster" in the template search box and press Enter.
Choose a classroom poster template. Select Customize this template if prompted, then click its text to add your own classroom message.
